rule: Synthetic acceptance cases, frozen before implementation. Expected outcomes, including expected losses and refusals, do not change after a result; a change needs a recorded successor disposition. Synthetic data only; no private content.

backup_cases.case: backups never configured
backup_cases.expected: no file written anywhere; status says off

backup_cases.case: configured on a separate physical disk; 24 h elapse
backup_cases.expected: one verified generation; last success recorded; failure domain 'separate physical disk' with evidence

backup_cases.case: host closed for 3 days, then reopened
backup_cases.expected: status shows paused then overdue; exactly one catch-up snapshot

backup_cases.case: two hosts of one project (linked worktrees) due at once
backup_cases.expected: one publisher; one generation; both show the same status

backup_cases.case: target on the store's own physical disk
backup_cases.expected: K5 same-drive warning; no drive-loss credit

backup_cases.case: target whose physical independence cannot be established
backup_cases.expected: domain reported unknown, never separate

backup_cases.case: target inside a known or declared sync root without consent
backup_cases.expected: refused; nothing written

backup_cases.case: consented cloud target, write not released
backup_cases.expected: snapshot held as due, with the reason; nothing written

backup_cases.case: target swapped for a symlink, junction, reparse point or a different mount after configuration
backup_cases.expected: write and prune refused; nothing deleted through the changed path

backup_cases.case: target overlaps a workspace, runtime or config root, or holds tracked content
backup_cases.expected: refused at configuration

backup_cases.case: write fails (permission or full disk)
backup_cases.expected: last good generation and last-success time unchanged; at most 3 transient attempts; failure shown

backup_cases.case: generations older than 30 days with a new verified generation
backup_cases.expected: old managed generations pruned; foreign directories untouched

backup_cases.case: replacement generation fails verification
backup_cases.expected: no prune; the last usable generation kept

backup_cases.case: item withdrawn after older generations hold it
backup_cases.expected: clean generation published, then older ones retired; offline target leaves cleanup pending and says so

backup_cases.case: withdrawal or purge during a snapshot
backup_cases.expected: the published generation and the deletion frontier agree; no withdrawn text served after restore

backup_cases.case: store volume lost, backups on
backup_cases.expected: restore from the newest verified backup into an empty store, with deletions applied

backup_cases.case: store volume lost, backups off
backup_cases.expected: expected loss: only the same-drive recovery copy, if any; status had shown the risk

backup_cases.case: verification key (ACL password) lost
backup_cases.expected: expected loss: authenticated restore refused, readably; plaintext may be imported as optional context only

backup_cases.case: deletion journal lost or shortened
backup_cases.expected: unknown deletion continuity refuses serving; never silently restores withdrawn items

backup_cases.case: encrypted backup requested
backup_cases.expected: refused with the 'Encryption unavailable' text; nothing written

backup_cases.case: corrupted generation bytes
backup_cases.expected: verification refuses restore

backup_cases.case: a published backup compared with the exact generation it copies
backup_cases.expected: byte-identical MEMORY.md, entries.jsonl and manifest.json; no normalizing or rewriting of signed bytes; bookkeeping kept outside them

backup_cases.case: restore into a non-empty store
backup_cases.expected: refused; nothing merged

backup_cases.case: restore of another registration's generation
backup_cases.expected: only under a confirmed controlled registry mapping; otherwise refused

backup_cases.case: publication interrupted (kill before, during and after the atomic publish)
backup_cases.expected: staging is never served or counted as a generation; the last good generation and status stay correct; next run cleans staging

backup_cases.case: restore interrupted at each staging step and around the atomic publication
backup_cases.expected: before publication: staging stays unserved and the store stays empty or recovery-required; after publication: the complete authenticated, deletion-reconciled generation may be present and served; restart reconciles the outcome with no partial publication and no duplication

backup_cases.case: restore of a snapshot older than later deletions
backup_cases.expected: deletions newer than the snapshot are reconciled from the freshest established journal before serving

backup_cases.case: backups disabled, or the target moved, after generations exist
backup_cases.expected: copy inventory still lists prior targets and generations; cleanup obligations for prior, offline or unwritable targets stay pending and visible

backup_cases.case: consented cloud or sync target relocated
backup_cases.expected: consent invalidated; writes refused until re-consented

backup_cases.case: /memory backup configure, status, now and disable
backup_cases.expected: bound host actions with confirmation where required; zero inference; no raw target path crosses the Gateway

backup_cases.case: status after local cleanup of a synced or external copy
backup_cases.expected: store, recovery, backup and external boundaries reported separately; no claim of cloud-history, recycle-bin or overall erasure

import_cases.case: valid MEMORY.md with linked topic files
import_cases.expected: preview lists each entry, mapping and disposition; nothing committed before apply

import_cases.case: apply with the exact preview digest after one-shot confirmation
import_cases.expected: per-item durable commits as legacy-import optional; status counts confirmed

import_cases.case: apply requested by model text, tool output, quoted or attached text
import_cases.expected: no mutation

import_cases.case: source file changed between preview and apply
import_cases.expected: apply refused; a new preview needed

import_cases.case: stale preview, wrong session or project, replay, cancellation
import_cases.expected: no mutation

import_cases.case: traversal, outside-root link, alias, unsafe ancestry
import_cases.expected: entry refused; listed as a coverage gap

import_cases.case: binary or unsupported encoding, control or bidi characters
import_cases.expected: file or entry refused; listed

import_cases.case: file over 1 MiB, total over 16 MiB, over 1000 entries, statement over 2000 chars
import_cases.expected: refused at the bound; over-limit statement refused whole

import_cases.case: link cycle
import_cases.expected: terminates by resolved file identity

import_cases.case: entry carrying a secret or an injected instruction
import_cases.expected: refused or off without statement; nothing executed or followed

import_cases.case: metadata claims user authorship, approval or a constraint
import_cases.expected: legacy-import optional or refused; never user-authored or protected

import_cases.case: entry conflicting with an existing user item
import_cases.expected: user item unchanged; conflict kept restrictive

import_cases.case: unmapped, ambiguous or other-project entry
import_cases.expected: not imported; reported refused with reason

import_cases.case: same import applied twice
import_cases.expected: no duplicates; second apply commits nothing new

import_cases.case: crash mid-apply, then resume
import_cases.expected: confirmed and uncertain items reported; resume never duplicates or retargets

import_cases.case: re-import of this project's own export
import_cases.expected: active entries dedupe; payload-free entries stay payload-free and inactive; origins kept, never promoted

import_cases.case: export from an older format without a source-origin field
import_cases.expected: origin recorded unavailable; nothing invented

import_cases.case: imported item later withdrawn or purged
import_cases.expected: Excluded from serving and from backup statement payloads; payload-free lifecycle/deletion records remain. Clean publication precedes retirement of affected older managed copies; unavailable cleanup remains pending.

import_cases.case: entry text overlapping raw source content (B1 source-overlap)
import_cases.expected: refused or off without statement, as the Gate does for candidates

import_cases.case: malformed entry (bad metadata syntax, empty statement, broken link target)
import_cases.expected: entry refused; listed with reason; other entries unaffected

import_cases.case: metadata forging a type (decision, constraint, approval) or a kind change
import_cases.expected: type not honoured; legacy-import optional fact or refused

import_cases.case: entry with stale anchors (file or symbol no longer matches)
import_cases.expected: restrictive state (reverify or off), never served as current

import_cases.case: entry with missing or broken lineage
import_cases.expected: off without statement payload or refused

import_cases.case: one invalid entry in a manifest
import_cases.expected: whole manifest validated before the first commit; dispositions shown; nothing committed for refused entries

import_cases.case: applied import
import_cases.expected: durable notices bound to actual commits; served-read records attribute served imported items, through the production import path

import_cases.case: authenticated restore of a generation versus import of the same generation
import_cases.expected: restore keeps authenticated lifecycle and provenance; import downgrades user claims to optional legacy-import

import_cases.case: round trip of off, withdrawn, purged and superseded source entries
import_cases.expected: each stays inactive; payload-free stays payload-free; superseded never becomes current

import_cases.case: import into a separate clone or fork registration versus a linked worktree
import_cases.expected: linked worktree shares the registration's imports; a clone or fork is a different registration and sees none

lifecycle_mapping: decisions.json oracle_mapping (Claude/Codex agreement required before Task 2 runs)

items: rotation and the four erasure states

pilot.status: bound only after the operator confirms sources, mapping, custody and comparison (D3)
pilot.negative_controls: items from other or unknown projects in the mixed Codex store must not enter the Optimus registration

revert_checks.rule: Each control is reverted alone; the named test must fail on the revert and pass on the restored code. Tests may be reused; names below are the planned targets in the plan's files table.
